sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店里做DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
Today, the Trump administration says that domestic abuse is no longer a basis for granting asylum in the United States.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普政府表示，家庭暴力不再是美国批准庇护申请的依据。

sentences.en: What that policy looks like to one victim.
sentences.zh: 这项政策对一位受害者意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 14th.
The United States of America is not some idea.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国不仅仅是一个概念。

sentences.en: It's not just a landmass or an economy.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅是一片土地或一种经济体。

sentences.en: Ours is a sovereign nation, nation-state with a constitution, laws, elections, borders.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个主权国家，一个拥有宪法、法律、选举和边界的民族国家。

sentences.en: And as you all well know, one of our major difficulties today is the asylum process.
sentences.zh: 正如大家所知，我们今天面临的主要困难之一就是庇护程序。

sentences.en: The asylum system is being abused to the detriment of the rule of law, sound public policy, public safety even, and to the detriment of people with just claims to asylum.
sentences.zh: 庇护制度正遭到滥用，这损害了法治、健全的公共政策、公共安全，甚至损害了那些真正有权申请庇护的人的利益。

sentences.en: On Monday, Attorney General Jeff Sessions went before a group of federal immigration judges to address a decision made under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 周一，司法部长杰夫·塞申斯在一群联邦移民法官面前，针对奥巴马总统任期内做出的一项决定发表了讲话。

sentences.en: Powerful incentives were created for aliens to come here illegally and claim fear of return.
sentences.zh: 这为外国人非法入境并声称害怕回国创造了强大的诱因。

sentences.en: In effect, word spread that by asserting this fear, they could remain in the United States one way or the other, and far too often that rumor proved correct.
sentences.zh: 实际上，有传言称只要声称这种恐惧，他们就能以某种方式留在美国，而这种传言往往被证明是正确的。

sentences.en: In 2014, a ruling based on Obama's more progressive immigration policies allowed asylum seekers to cite the threat of domestic violence as the basis for asylum,
sentences.zh: 2014年，一项基于奥巴马更进步的移民政策的裁决，允许庇护申请者以家庭暴力威胁作为申请庇护的依据，

sentences.en: if they were coming from countries where their governments would not protect them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们来自政府无法保护他们的国家。

sentences.en: The results are just what one would expect.
sentences.zh: 结果正如人们所预料的那样。

sentences.en: The number of illegal entrants has surged, credible fear claims have skyrocketed,
sentences.zh: 非法入境人数激增，声称有“可信恐惧”的人数呈指数级增长，

sentences.en: and the percentage of asylum claims found to be meritorious by our judges has declined significantly.
sentences.zh: 而我们的法官认定有价值的庇护申请比例却大幅下降。

sentences.en: On Monday, Sessions said he would end that approach.
sentences.zh: 周一，塞申斯表示他将终止这种做法。

sentences.en: Now we all know that many of those crossing the border illegally are leaving difficult, even dangerous conditions,
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，许多非法越境的人正处于困难甚至危险的境地，

sentences.en: and we understand that all are due proper respect in court and the proper legal process.
sentences.zh: 我们也理解，所有人都应在法庭上得到应有的尊重和正当的法律程序。

sentences.en: But we cannot abandon legal discipline and sound legal concepts.
sentences.zh: 但我们不能放弃法律纪律和健全的法律概念。

sentences.en: So just sit naturally, like you're going to sit during the interview, and I'm going to move this towards you, and then Jess, you'll let me know how things sound.
sentences.zh: 就这样自然地坐着，就像你采访时那样，我会把这个移向你，杰斯，你帮我听听声音怎么样。

sentences.en: Can you talk a little bit?
Yeah, tell us what you have for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 好的，告诉我们你早餐吃了什么。

sentences.en: Cereal and bananas.
What kind of cereal?
I almost said cereal, but I decided to have toaSt.
sentences.zh: 我本来想说麦片，但后来决定吃吐司。

sentences.en: I'm really grateful that you came in here, so thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你能来这里，真的很感谢。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
What should I call you?
What name would you like us to use?
sentences.zh: 你希望我们用什么名字？

sentences.en: Mariam.
Mariam.
Tell me about where you're from.
I'm from Burkina Faso.
It's a little country in the middle of Nigeria, Ghana, Mali, Benet, Togo.
sentences.zh: 那是一个位于尼日利亚、加纳、马里、贝宁、多哥中间的小国。

sentences.en: So, West Africa.
Ivory Coast, yes, in West Africa.
Yes, we speak French.
And tell me a little bit about your family in Burkina Faso.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你在布基纳法索的家人吧。

sentences.en: What was your family like?
It's a big family.
It's a family of 11 people.
Yes, and we have a lot of cousins and aunts, uncles.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们还有很多表亲、阿姨和叔叔。

sentences.en: We love each other.
We live like a family, and everybody knows everybody and know their stories.
sentences.zh: 我们像一家人一样生活，每个人都认识每个人，也了解彼此的故事。

sentences.en: Yep.
So, no secrets.
No secrets.
You cannot hide something there.
sentences.zh: 你在那里藏不住任何东西。

sentences.en: Everybody knows everything about anyone.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道关于任何人的所有事情。

sentences.en: And what did you do for fun when you were growing up?
sentences.zh: 你小时候喜欢做什么娱乐活动？

sentences.en: For fun, I like to sing gospel.
sentences.zh: 为了好玩，我喜欢唱福音歌曲。

sentences.en: To sing gospel.
Yep.
So, Christian music.
Christian music, yeah.
When you were growing up, did you have a favorite song in French that you sang?
sentences.zh: 你小时候有特别喜欢唱的法语歌吗？

sentences.en: In French, yes.
What was that song?
In Yakuutu, I say, yeah.
sentences.zh: 用雅库图语唱的，我记得。

sentences.en: It's Only You, Jesus.
It's Only You, Jesus?
Yeah.
This song, we sing it at church.
Mm-hmm.
Every service, before the prayer starts, we sing it.
sentences.zh: 每次礼拜，在祈祷开始前，我们都会唱。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
When I'm singing that, I remember all my suffering.
sentences.zh: 当我唱这首歌时，我会想起我所有的苦难。

sentences.en: When I was back in home, when I was singing that, I was in tears.
sentences.zh: 当我在家乡时，唱这首歌我会流泪。

sentences.en: But now, when I sing that, I remember all the good things that God did for me.
sentences.zh: 但现在，当我唱这首歌时，我想到的是上帝为我所做的一切美好之事。

sentences.en: I want to hear the story about your suffering, as you said.
sentences.zh: 我想听听你说的关于苦难的故事。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
And I wonder where that story begins.
sentences.zh: 我想知道那个故事是从哪里开始的。

sentences.en: This story begins on, like, 2005, when I met him.
sentences.zh: 故事开始于2005年左右，我遇见他的时候。

sentences.en: When you were 18?
When I met a guy, I met him because he's not far from my house.
sentences.zh: 我遇见了一个男人，因为他住得离我家不远。

sentences.en: And every time that I'm going to school, he was there.
sentences.zh: 每次我去学校，他都在那里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
And every time I'm passing, I say hello.
sentences.zh: 每次我经过，我都会打招呼。

sentences.en: You'd wave to him.
So, you made eye contact.
Yep.
Yes.
And we start dating.
He said that he loved me.
And he started giving me and my friend little gifts.
sentences.zh: 他开始给我和我的朋友送些小礼物。

sentences.en: Sometimes he bought us cookies, Fanta, Coca.
sentences.zh: 有时他会给我们买饼干、芬达、可乐。

sentences.en: Fanta, the drink?
Yes.
And we were happy.
We think that, yes, he's the good person.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得，是的，他是个好人。

sentences.en: He's the right person.
Mm-hmm.
He wanted me to be, us together, to be more.
sentences.zh: 他想让我们在一起，更进一步。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
I was pregnant.
And now...
You become pregnant.
Yes, I become pregnant.
He went to pay a dowry to my family.
My dowry is silver and money.
Mm-hmm.
He paid it.
And when he paid it, I moved to his house.
sentences.zh: 付完之后，我就搬到了他家。

sentences.en: Why is that...
Why is the dowry important?
The dowry symbolize, like, you are not for your family anymore.
sentences.zh: 彩礼象征着你不再属于你的家庭了。

sentences.en: You are for the guy, because he paid you his belonging.
sentences.zh: 你属于那个男人，因为他付钱买下了你。

sentences.en: And when they give you a dowry, your parents don't have any word to say anymore.
sentences.zh: 当他们给了彩礼，你的父母就再也没有话语权了。

sentences.en: You can say, like, he's buying you.
Mm-hmm.
And I moved there.
And when I moved to his house, I found out that he was married.
sentences.zh: 搬到他家后，我发现他其实结过婚。

sentences.en: He asked another lady, but the lady left.
sentences.zh: 他之前向另一个女人求婚，但那个女人离开了。

sentences.en: Okay.
And he was two kids in the house.
And now I was supposed to take care of the kids and his family.
sentences.zh: 现在我得照顾这些孩子和他的家人。

sentences.en: And are you okay with that?
Yes, because the kids were sweet.
sentences.zh: 没意见，因为孩子们很可爱。

sentences.en: They're very nice.
They don't have bad attitude.
And because they miss their mom, when they see me, they took me like a mom.
sentences.zh: 因为他们想念妈妈，看到我时，就把我当成了妈妈。

sentences.en: And we were good together.
Mm-hmm.
Yes.
It sounds like you love him.
Yes, before I loved him.
Before?
Yeah.
When we started to live together, I realized that he was not kind.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始住在一起，我意识到他并不善良。

sentences.en: He was not kind.
And every time he liked to fight, and he liked to watch football.
sentences.zh: 他总是喜欢打架，喜欢看足球。

sentences.en: And when the team don't win, the day he makes problems, he likes to drink.
sentences.zh: 当球队输球时，那天他就会制造麻烦，他喜欢喝酒。

sentences.en: Every time he makes probleMs.
Mm-hmm.
Like humiliating me in front of his friend, in front of his mom.
sentences.zh: 比如在朋友和母亲面前羞辱我。

sentences.en: And nobody says nothing.
He's telling me bad words sometimes.
sentences.zh: 他有时会对我恶语相向。

sentences.en: And he's telling me that I'm fat, I'm so ugly.
Because this time I was pregnant, and I cannot take care of myself like before.
sentences.zh: 因为那时我怀孕了，无法像以前那样照顾自己。

sentences.en: That sounds awful.
Mm-hmm.
It was awful.
Do you remember the first time that he became violent with you?
sentences.zh: 你还记得他第一次对你施暴是什么时候吗？

sentences.en: When I started saying no, is why he started beating me.
sentences.zh: 我开始拒绝他的时候，就是他开始打我的时候。

sentences.en: Firstly, I took that as normal, but after it was too much, he can beat me, and he see the blood, he don't stop.
sentences.zh: 起初，我以为这是正常的，但后来太过分了，他打我，看到血了，他也不停手。

sentences.en: He draws blood and doesn't stop.
sentences.zh: 他打得我流血了，却不停手。

sentences.en: Yes, he doesn't stop to beat me.
sentences.zh: 是的，他打我时根本停不下来。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
How often was this happening in a given week?
sentences.zh: 这种情况一周大概发生多少次？

sentences.en: Four times, three times a week.
Mm-hmm.
Yes.
Anything make him angry.
And I didn't want to go, but he's forcing me.
He said that what I think that he paid the dowry to.
sentences.zh: 他说他付了彩礼，我得听他的。

sentences.en: He paid the dowry because of that.
sentences.zh: 他就是因为付了彩礼才这么说。

sentences.en: I cannot live in his house and eat the food and don't want to agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我不能住他的房子，吃他的饭，却不顺从他。

sentences.en: But it's because of that he paid the dowry.
sentences.zh: 但他就是因为付了彩礼才这么认为。

sentences.en: So he's saying that you must have sex with him.
sentences.zh: 所以他的意思是，你必须和他发生性关系。

sentences.en: Yes, because he paid the dowry for that.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为他付了彩礼，买的就是这个。

sentences.en: I'm not his sister.
Mm-hmm.
So he's forcing you to do this.
sentences.zh: 所以他在强迫你做这些事。

sentences.en: Yes, he's forcing me.
Mm-hmm.
And that dowry, that means to you that you cannot leave?
sentences.zh: 那笔彩礼，对你来说意味着你无法离开吗？

sentences.en: You can't because if you leave, your family will not be happy with you, and it will be a shame in the town.
sentences.zh: 你没法离开，因为如果你走了，你的家人会不高兴，这在镇上会是件丢脸的事。

sentences.en: Everybody will be speaking about you.
Mm-hmm.
And maybe he can come to the family and tell the family that you are not here.
sentences.zh: 而且他可能会去找你的家人，告诉他们你不在那儿了。

sentences.en: You need another woman.
Mm-hmm.
Yes.
So he could then seek out another member of your family.
sentences.zh: 所以他可能会去找你家里的其他人。

sentences.en: Yeah, because you guys take his dowry.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为你们拿了他的彩礼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
Yes.
So if you leave, you might inflict that on somebody else you love and your family.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你离开，你可能会把这种灾难带给你爱的人和你的家人。

sentences.en: Yes, because they still have the dowry.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为他们还拿着那笔彩礼。

sentences.en: Wow.
Maren, when was the first time that you felt that your life might be in danger in this marriage?
sentences.zh: Maren，你第一次感觉到在这段婚姻中生命受到威胁是什么时候？

sentences.en: When I felt that my life would be in danger is when I lost my baby.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到生命受到威胁，是在我流产的时候。

sentences.en: You have a miscarriage.
Yes.
We fight one night.
He beat me everywhere, and I was sick.
sentences.zh: 他把我浑身都打了一遍，我病倒了。

sentences.en: And three days later, I see the blood and everything.
sentences.zh: 三天后，我看到流血了，什么都发生了。

sentences.en: It's that time that I realized that if I can lose my baby, I can lose my life.
sentences.zh: 就在那时我意识到，如果我连孩子都能失去，我也可能会丢掉性命。

sentences.en: And one night, we fight.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，我们吵架了。

sentences.en: And when we started fighting, he was screaming.
sentences.zh: 我们开始打架时，他在尖叫。

sentences.en: He was screaming.
Yes.
And when we went to the kitchen and he took the knife, I thought he was playing because since we fight, he never took a knife.
sentences.zh: 当我们走进厨房，他拿起了刀，我以为他是在闹着玩，因为以前打架时他从没拿过刀。

sentences.en: Every time he's a belt or his shoes.
sentences.zh: 每次他都用皮带或鞋子。

sentences.en: And I thought that it was a game, a joke.
sentences.zh: 我以为那只是个游戏，是个玩笑。

sentences.en: He wanted to scare me.
But he stabbed my back twice.
sentences.zh: 但他朝我的背上捅了两刀。

sentences.en: He stabbed you in the back?
Yes.
Twice.
And after the hospital, we went back home.
sentences.zh: 从医院回来后，我们回了家。

sentences.en: I told him, go away.
I don't want to go with you anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也不想和你在一起了。

sentences.en: It's finished.
And now...
You went to your...
My parents' house.
This was it for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说就是终点了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
I said, I'm not going.
He can do anything that he wants, but I'm not going anymore.
sentences.zh: 他想做什么都行，但我再也不会回去了。

sentences.en: And one night, we were sleeping in the house.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，我们正在屋里睡觉。

sentences.en: I was sleeping, me and my two little sisters.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在睡觉，我和我的两个小妹妹。

sentences.en: Because our bed is...
Three people can sleep here.
And one or two o'clock in the morning, it came with this big truck.
sentences.zh: 凌晨一两点的时候，他开着那辆大卡车来了。

sentences.en: It entered in my bedroom.
So, the truck took the bed and dropped us to the wall.
sentences.zh: 卡车撞上了床，把我们推到了墙上。

sentences.en: The roof collapsed.
He drives the truck into the bedroom?
Yes, the truck in my bedroom, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，卡车开进了我的卧室，没错。

sentences.en: Wow.
And...
Were you injured?
Yes.
This is a serious crap.
My leg and my sisters, she said that she couldn't breathe anymore.
sentences.zh: 我的腿受伤了，我妹妹说她快喘不过气了。

sentences.en: And my dad called the police at this time.
And the police did everything.
They measured everything.
We went to the hospital.
And the police, too, said that it's because I'm not respectful.
sentences.zh: 警察也说，这是因为我不懂尊重。

sentences.en: I have to be humble.
I have to respect my husband.
If I'm not respecting my husband, it's what happened.
sentences.zh: 如果我不尊重丈夫，就会发生这种事。

sentences.en: And my dad tried to call the insurance people, too.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸也试着联系了保险公司。

sentences.en: The insurance said that it's a family problem.
sentences.zh: 保险公司说这是家庭纠纷。

sentences.en: Police, too, said that it's a family problem.
sentences.zh: 警察也说这是家庭纠纷。

sentences.en: We have to deal with that.
Everyone's telling you that it's...
Yes.
It's your problem.
So, you've left the house at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以，你当时已经离开了那个家。

sentences.en: You've gone to the police.
What else is there left for you to do?
I didn't have nothing to do anymore because my country is too small.
sentences.zh: 我什么也做不了了，因为我的国家太小了。

sentences.en: You cannot hide something from nobody in my country.
sentences.zh: 在我的国家，你无法向任何人隐瞒任何事。

sentences.en: I went to my uncle and my uncle said that you cannot stay here.
sentences.zh: 我去找了叔叔，叔叔说你不能待在这里。

sentences.en: Even in Africa, you cannot stay.
sentences.zh: 即使在非洲，你也待不下去。

sentences.en: That you have to leave.
You have to leave.
And I applied for the visa to the United States.
sentences.zh: 于是我申请了去美国的签证。

sentences.en: Why the United States?
United States because the United States will protect me more.
sentences.zh: 因为美国能给我更多保护。

sentences.en: I was watching on the TV, the movies.
It's a show that they call Cosby.
sentences.zh: 有个节目叫《考斯比一家》。

sentences.en: It was a black family.
The Cosby show.
Yes.
And he was respecting the lady every time.
sentences.zh: 里面的男主人总是很尊重那位女士。

sentences.en: And I see our men respect ladies.
sentences.zh: 我看到我们的男人尊重女性。

sentences.en: It's why I said that this is my dream.
sentences.zh: 所以我说这就是我的梦想。

sentences.en: It's this kind of life I needed.
I wanted it.
It was my dream.
And I said that this is the perfect place to be safe.
sentences.zh: 我说这就是最安全的地方。

sentences.en: So, where do you first arrive in the United States?
sentences.zh: 那么，你刚到美国时是在哪里？

sentences.en: I took the plane and I arrived at JFK in New York.
sentences.zh: 我坐飞机到了纽约的肯尼迪机场。

sentences.en: Okay.
In Queens.
When we arrived at JFK, we arrived at the immigration services.
sentences.zh: 我们到达肯尼迪机场后，去了移民局。

sentences.en: And because my English was bad, I didn't speak English.
sentences.zh: 因为我的英语很差，我不会说英语。

sentences.en: I said, no, no, go back.
Stay.
No more Burkina Faso.
sentences.zh: 不要再回布基纳法索了。

sentences.en: You were telling them that...
No, I'm not going back.
You want to stay here.
Yes.
I was requesting, like, asylum.
Asylum.
So, you're asking...
Yes.
You're asking for protection from the U.S.
You're asking for asylum.
And they understand this.
Yes.
And where do you go next?
Went to a small room where a lot of people come, like police.
sentences.zh: 被带到一个小房间，很多人来了，就像警察一样。

sentences.en: They come now starting to speak with me.
sentences.zh: 他们现在开始跟我谈话了。

sentences.en: I was scared.
You were scared?
I was scared that they would send me back, force me to go to the plane.
sentences.zh: 我当时很害怕他们会把我遣返回去，强迫我上飞机。

sentences.en: But a guy came and asked me a question.
sentences.zh: 但有个人走过来问了我一个问题。

sentences.en: And I end up in detention in New York.
sentences.zh: 最后我被关进了纽约的拘留所。

sentences.en: You ask for asylum and they take you to a detention facility.
sentences.zh: 你申请庇护，他们就会把你带到拘留设施。

sentences.en: Yes, to detention.
Yes, it was scary.
So, at this point, you've come to the United States on a tourist visa.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时你是持旅游签证来到美国的。

sentences.en: You have asked for asylum.
You're brought to a detention center.
sentences.zh: 然后你被带到了拘留中心。

sentences.en: Yes.
How do you feel at this point?
I feel very sad.
No French-speaking person was there.
sentences.zh: 那里没有会说法语的人。

sentences.en: At this point, you don't speak very much English, the way you do now.
sentences.zh: 当时你的英语还不太好，不像现在这样。

sentences.en: No, it's them they were teaching me.
And one Jamaican girl, she was teaching me very well.
sentences.zh: 有个牙买加女孩，她教得非常好。

sentences.en: So, other women in detention are starting to teach you English.
sentences.zh: 所以，拘留所里的其他女性开始教你英语了。

sentences.en: Yes, to teach me English.
And they teach you a song to sing.
What song did they teach you to sing?
I was singing, God Will Make a Way for Me.
sentences.zh: 我唱的是《上帝会为我开辟道路》（God Will Make a Way for Me）。

sentences.en: God Will Make a Way.
God Will Make a Way.
Yes.
Do you know the words of it?
What are some of the words to the song?
sentences.zh: 这首歌的歌词大概是什么？

sentences.en: God will make a way.
Where they seem to me, no way.
sentences.zh: 在看似无路可走的地方。

sentences.en: He works in ways we cannot see.
sentences.zh: 他以我们无法预见的方式行事。

sentences.en: He will make a way for me.
He will be my God.
Hold me to all...
No, I forgot.
Sorry.
You might be nervous because you're in front of a microphone.
sentences.zh: 你可能会因为面对麦克风而紧张。

sentences.en: It's beautiful.
It means my freedom.
I know we were singing that all the ladies together every night before to pray.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们每天晚上祈祷前，所有的女士都会一起唱这首歌。

sentences.en: It's there.
I learned it.
So, you're in this detention facility.
sentences.zh: 所以，你当时在拘留设施里。

sentences.en: You're waiting for the United States to decide...
sentences.zh: 你在等待美国做出决定……

sentences.en: Yes.
...whether or not you can stay.
Whether you can be granted asylum.
sentences.zh: 决定你是否能获得庇护。

sentences.en: What happened with your case?
I stayed here six months.
The first month that I arrived, I was able to get a lawyer, pro bono lawyer.
sentences.zh: 刚到的第一个月，我就找到了一位律师，一位公益律师。

sentences.en: He took my case and he told me that, do you have your proof, your evidence?
sentences.zh: 他接手了我的案子，问我：你有证据吗？

sentences.en: I said, I have everything in my suitcase.
sentences.zh: 我说，我行李箱里什么都有。

sentences.en: She said, wow.
You plan it?
I said, yes.
I plan everything.
I have all the proof in my suitcase.
sentences.zh: 我行李箱里有所有的证据。

sentences.en: And I have to show them all my scars in my body.
sentences.zh: 我还得向他们展示我身上所有的伤疤。

sentences.en: And when we went to court, they granted me the asylum.
sentences.zh: 当我们上法庭时，他们批准了我的庇护申请。

sentences.en: Wow.
What does your life look like now in the U.S., Miriam?
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，你现在在美国的生活怎么样？

sentences.en: I don't have to worry about nothing now.
sentences.zh: 我现在什么都不用担心了。

sentences.en: Since I'm here, nobody never slapped me or tell me bad things.
sentences.zh: 自从我来到这里，从来没有人打过我，也没人对我说过难听的话。

sentences.en: It's sometimes on the metro, people say, oh, fuck you, something like that.
sentences.zh: 偶尔在地铁上，有人会说，哦，去你的，之类的。

sentences.en: It's only on the metro.
And even it's the metro from New York, in New Jersey, nobody never told me that.
sentences.zh: 而且即使是在纽约去新泽西的地铁上，也从来没人那样对我。

sentences.en: That's just life in New York, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是纽约的生活吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm very happy.
I'm going to school now.
I want to improve my English.
sentences.zh: 我想提高我的英语水平。

sentences.en: And when I will be able to speak good English, I will help all the organizations fighting against domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 等我能说一口流利的英语时，我会去帮助所有反对家庭暴力的组织。

sentences.en: You want to help other women?
Yes, I will help other women.
sentences.zh: 是的，我会帮助其他女性。

sentences.en: Is there anything that has surprised you about life in America?
sentences.zh: 在美国的生活有什么让你感到惊讶的事吗？

sentences.en: Anything that has made you laugh?
sentences.zh: 有什么让你觉得好笑的事吗？

sentences.en: Yes, a lot of things make me laugh.
sentences.zh: 是的，很多事情都让我觉得好笑。

sentences.en: Like what?
When I see men taking care of kids here, like rolling the stroller, it makes me laugh.
sentences.zh: 当我看到这里的男人照顾孩子，比如推着婴儿车时，这让我觉得好笑。

sentences.en: Because in Africa, no way.
sentences.zh: 因为在非洲，这根本不可能。

sentences.en: And sometimes I explain to my friend in Africa, they say, oh my God, don't tell me that.
sentences.zh: 有时我跟非洲的朋友解释，她们会说，天哪，别跟我开玩笑了。

sentences.en: Yes, when I explain to them.
sentences.zh: 是的，当我跟她们解释时。

sentences.en: Don't tell me that men do that.
sentences.zh: 别告诉我男人会做那种事。

sentences.en: They are very surprised, yes.

sentences.zh: 那你在这里认识什么人了吗？

sentences.en: Have you gotten close to anybody?
Yes.
I'm in love now.
Yes.
I didn't know that I can be in love again.
sentences.zh: 我以前不知道自己还能再恋爱。

sentences.en: But it starts again.
I met him on TJ Maxx.
At TJ Maxx?
Yes, I went to shop and he came to shop and he was speaking French.
sentences.zh: 是的，我去购物，他也去购物，他当时在说法语。

sentences.en: I speak French too.
And we start like this.
And how long have you been dating him?
Almost one year, six months.
Wow.
Yep.
We talk, we laugh.
We're going to restaurants to watch movies.
Yes.
One night, we wanted to hang out.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，我们想出去玩。

sentences.en: I like to wear long pants and dresses to cover myself because I don't want nobody to see my wounds.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢穿长裤和裙子遮住自己，因为我不想让任何人看到我的伤口。

sentences.en: But he's telling me, don't worry.
Leave that.
I like it.
No problem.
You don't have to hide everything.
He accepts my story.
He knows everything.
What happened?
And he accepts it.
So he understands.
Yes, he understands.

sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，我很好奇，如果你没能留在美国，你会怎么办？

sentences.en: I know that with this guy, I would lose my life if I didn't get to stay here.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果我没能留在这里，我肯定会没命的。

sentences.en: And I would put all my family in danger.
sentences.zh: 而且我还会让我的全家人陷入危险。

sentences.en: If you'd been sent back, you believe you would be dead?
sentences.zh: 如果你被遣返回去，你认为你会死吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
It was out of control.
America was the way.
Like we said, God can make the way.
sentences.zh: 就像我们说的，上帝会开辟道路。

sentences.en: It's America.
Because God walked in a ways.
I think that this way is America, was America.
sentences.zh: 我认为这条路就是美国，曾经是美国。

sentences.en: And if America wants to close this way, I don't know where we will go.
sentences.zh: 如果美国想要关闭这条路，我不知道我们还能去哪里。

sentences.en: You can imagine what will happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象会发生什么。

sentences.en: Miram, I really want to thank you.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，我真的非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
You're very welcome.
Thank you.
Yes.

sentences.zh: 很抱歉我的英语不好，因为这是我的第二语言。

sentences.en: Your English is very good.
I would like to explain more than that.
sentences.zh: 我想表达的远不止这些。

sentences.en: But I don't have the words.
You have the words.
So I don't have the words.
You really do.
Yeah.

sentences.zh: 你还会想起和你丈夫在一起的那段时光吗？

sentences.en: Does it come back to you?
Yes, it comes back to me.

sentences.zh: 每当我想到非洲或者看到我的伤口时，我就会想起他。

sentences.en: He cannot pass away, but I try to forget.
sentences.zh: 他虽然不在了，但我试着去忘记。

sentences.en: But a lot of things made me remember.
sentences.zh: 但很多事情还是会让我记起。

sentences.en: And how do you deal with it when you think about it?
sentences.zh: 当你想到这些时，你是怎么应对的？

sentences.en: When you look at your scars and you think about him?
sentences.zh: 当你看着伤疤想起他的时候？

sentences.en: I think it's about the new life.
sentences.zh: 我想，这关乎我的新生活。

sentences.en: I don't want to remember, yes, this anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不想再想起这些了，是的。

sentences.en: I think about the freedom now that I have.
sentences.zh: 我现在只想着我拥有的自由。

sentences.en: And I'm thankful to that.
And every time that I'm sad, I'm singing.
sentences.zh: 每当我难过时，我就会唱歌。

sentences.en: God will make a way, when it seems to be no way.

sentences.en: He works in ways we cannot see.

sentences.en: He will make a way for me.

Hold me closely to his side.

sentences.en: With love and strength for each new day.
